corpusPolicy.syntheticProse: generated at test runtime only; machine report stores counts and bytes, never prose

discoveryCompositeDispatch.requiredName: executes named and empty-query discovery locally through the composite runtime read scheduler

discoveryRetryAfterFailure.requiredName: reuses discovered schemas after a write and explicit retry across restart (failed)

discoveryRetryAfterAbort.requiredName: reuses discovered schemas after a write and explicit retry across restart (aborted)

discoveryRetryAfterInterruption.requiredName: reuses discovered schemas after a write and explicit retry across restart (interrupted)

fixedToolPrefix.requiredName: keeps a complete directory and fixed tools while schemas arrive only in tool results

discoveryPermissions.requiredName: authorizes the real write and never grants authority through the read-only dispatcher

discoveryRecovery.requiredName: can switch to full schemas and back without invalidating discovered history

discoveryProviderWire.requiredName: preserves openai-codex schemas, call IDs and encrypted reasoning through search/read/write/synthesis

longBookContext.requiredName: preserves literary evidence and author constraints across 200k multi-slice compaction, restart, and compactor faults

syntheticBookRetrieval.requiredName: recalls canon, voice, aliases, writing rules, and chapter evidence from the synthetic fixture

providerTarget.requiredName: installs the default model declaration without a separate product target

providerCannotBeEnlarged.requiredName: never enlarges a smaller provider declaration with a DEV override

undeclaredProviderFallback.requiredName: uses a conservative window for an undeclared custom driver

safeCompactorFallback.requiredName: leaves committed-write proof to durable receipts and rejects forged provider evidence

sameTurnOversize.requiredName: compacts older tool batches inside one oversized current turn

sameTurnChunking.requiredName: chunks inside one turn at tool-topology boundaries without splitting a pair

boundedCompactorCalls.requiredName: stops after enough chunk gain instead of compacting all history

declaredModelWindows.requiredName: uses discovered model windows without standard or Max caps

retiredContextPreference.requiredName: retires a persisted Max preference of false

mixedChunkGain.requiredName: keeps a no-gain short chunk exact while applying profitable full-compactor chunks

activeTurnWriteDelta.requiredName: drops same-turn pre-write prose after recovery while retaining the successful delta

focusedWorkingCopy.requiredName: keeps one complete same-turn working copy across focused authored edits

supersededRead.requiredName: drops an older complete read when a newer complete read covers the same authored object

obsoleteSummaryRetirement.requiredName: retires a cached summary when a later read makes one covered source discardable

multiChapterWorkingSet.requiredName: keeps a bounded multi-chapter authored working set exact when it fits the window

noopContextRetirement.requiredName: drops a successful side-effect-free write while retaining an unresolved write

noopWriteSettlement.requiredName: settles a workspace no-op as success without claiming a durable effect

durableReadProgress.requiredName: keeps complete authored reading as current domain state after body and summary writes

domainReadProgressPresentation.requiredName: retains full-read and current-summary state without transport vocabulary

wholeChapterSummaryReview.requiredName: commits whole-chapter prose and summary together and restores the summary when one block is rejected

wholeChapterSummaryRollback.requiredName: rolls back prose, summary, Yjs receipt, and sync journal when their shared transaction fails

artifactRestart.requiredName: pages exact Unicode content after closing and reopening the repository

checkpointRestart.requiredName: commits the final assistant atomically, restarts, verifies nested integrity, and resumes canonical history

interruptedContinuation.requiredName: preserves interrupted author intent and completed reads through repeated restart and a completed continuation (writes: false)

interruptedWriteSafety.requiredName: preserves interrupted author intent and completed reads through repeated restart and a completed continuation (writes: true)

atomicContinuation.requiredName: atomically accepts continuation context and rejects altered or partial acceptance replays

duplicateWriteReplay.requiredName: persists one authorized effect and replays duplicates without mutation or post-write review

longTaskIdempotency.requiredName: uses one crash-safe command transaction with exact replay and CAS

boundaries.generatedProseQuality: This gate proves context availability and fidelity, not that every provider writes excellent prose; semantic writing judgment is milestone H.
boundaries.providerNetwork: Provider contracts are bounded and deterministic here; live multi-provider conformance is milestone I.
boundaries.nativeDevices: SQLite process restart is covered headlessly; desktop/iOS/Android lifecycle and endurance are milestone J.
